episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Three members of the one family have confronting, joyous and heart-warming experiences of love as they deal with the complexity of their personal relationships.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: It's Christine's funeral. Glen, Clara and Aaron have very different emotional responses to their grief which propels them each on a new path.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Glen's holiday is turning in to something unexpectedly enjoyable, Clara goes on a date with Peter and Aaron can't believe everyone is moving on from his mother's death so soon.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As life and love starts to flourish for Glen, Clara and Aaron, they're each momentarily jolted back a step to reconsider their choices.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After scattering the ashes of their Mum, Clara and Aaron meet their Dad's new love and their own relationships take yet another turn.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Glen and Anita prepare for the wedding, while Aaron receives some news that threatens his new relationship with Jesse and Clara tries to work things out with Peter.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: With Aaron a soon to be a father and Glen happily living with his new wife Anita, Clara and Peter decide they want to start a family.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Glen is increasingly suspicious with Anita's mysterious calls and absence, while Peter and Clara have his ex over for dinner which ends with Peter demanding a paternity test.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Glen finally meets the mysterious man in Anita's life while Peter and Clara struggle under the pressure of starting a family.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Glen, Clara and Aaron's relationships struggle under pressure, they each find themselves alone again.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Clara and Peter struggle to move past the night before, but when Glen and Peter rescue Aaron from a drunk night in Sorrento, it gives the men some time to reflect.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As the Mathieson's prepare to sell the family home, each relationship takes a turn for the better.
